CustomObject.description: G1d. Org-wide config for the custom-domain go-live flow — currently just the host a customer's domain should CNAME to (the classic Site host serving WebsitePublicSite.page). One active record, Name = "Default". Kept as metadata rather than hardcoded in WebsuiteDomainController so it survives an org migration by editing one record instead of a code change — see docs/url-contract.md §8.
